lenses.sp: Wants a large, steady, cheap company with a strong balance sheet.

ch.r: Long-term debt ≤ current assets − current liabilities

ch.w: Graham wanted the short-term cushion alone to be able to repay long-term loans.

v4.ll: Passes Graham, Buffett, Munger, Lynch, Fisher, Greenblatt, F-score, Kedia, Agrawal-style checks
ch: Drops to Hold if the quality score falls below 70 (now 73); to Avoid below 50.

Buy zone: below ₹135 (25% under the absolute value ₹180, 🛡️ Strict view), if the view's own conditions hold, confidence is Medium or High and the trend is up. Accumulate zone: ₹177–₹239 (consensus ₹208).
Profit spike: no Buy until 2 quarters after the spike year each earn at least ₹510 crore (so far 1 reported).
Moves to Trim above ₹270 (30% over fair value).
'Good but wait' turns into Buy when the price closes above its 200-day average ₹123 (or its 12-1 month return reaches the top half of its sector).

Any new serious red flag (auditor resigns mid-term, pledge above 25%, SEBI order, negative net worth, weak cash conversion together with high accruals, distress with interest cover below 1.5×) moves it straight to Avoid.
